practicalCriteria: Each pre-start, during-job and completion tick is backed by a recorded observation
Each hazard has a recorded control, and any uncontrolled hazard has a recorded decision before the affected task starts
Each scope change is recorded with a photo reference and an agreed decision made before the extra work
Customer sign-off is recorded after inspection, or the reason it was not given is recorded
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
evidenceRequired: photo record as set by the business
stopWorkCriteria: Do not start a task while a pre-start hazard is not controlled and no decision is recorded
Do not record customer sign-off before the customer has inspected the work
Stop and record a change in scope before carrying out any extra work
